From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Medivance: Request for BYO key attestation and TLS details (internal)

Tessa / team — internal technical answers below (export this into the consolidated packet).

1) BYOK import flow (summary):
- Customer generates root wrapping key (RSA 3072 or RSA 4096 recommended) in their KMS/HSM.
- Customer exports a wrapped key blob using RSA-OAEP-SHA256 (we support RSA-OAEP and RSA-OAEP-256).
- Import endpoint: for Redwood Hosted, wrapped keys are received over an mTLS-protected import endpoint then sealed into Redwood's HSM cluster (CloudHSM for hosted). For Dedicated, import can be performed into the customer's dedicated pool (customer-managed HSM options) or into Redwood-managed HSMs with explicit attestation. For Private (VPC/on-prem) the import is performed directly into the customer's HSM via an administrative connector (no raw key traverses Redwood control plane).
- The import operation is logged as KMS_IMPORT in the KMS audit stream with a unique import-id, timestamp, and requester principal.

2) HSM compatibility / onboarding:
- Supported vendors: AWS CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM, Thales Luna (via partner connector), SafeNet for on-prem integrations.
- Diagram: see attached hsm-integration-diagram.png — shows separation of control plane vs data plane for each deployment mode.
- Attestation behavior: for Hosted and Dedicated managed HSMs we provide a signed attestation outlining key residency and export constraints. For Private/on-prem we provide connectors and attestations specific to customer setup.

3) Key rotation policy and automation:
- Default rotation: symmetric data encryption keys are rotated every 90 days by default; master wrapping keys rotated annually unless customer-specific policy overrides.
- Customer-scheduled rotation: supported via API and scheduled-rollover jobs; we provide a rotation API and webhook for rollout completion events.
- Audit/automation hooks: KMS_ROTATE, KMS_IMPORT, KMS_EXPORT-WRAPPED events are emitted; customers can forward audit streams to their SIEM or pull via the audit API. Retention: default 365 days; enterprise retention options available to 7 years.

4) TLS configuration:
- Minimum TLS: TLS1.2 with strong ciphers; TLS1.3 fully supported and recommended for all endpoints.
- Cipher suites: we prioritize AEAD suites (e.g., TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384). For TLS1.2 we require ECDHE + AESGCM or CHACHA20-POLY1305.
- mTLS: Private/on-prem and Dedicated appliance endpoints support mutual TLS for key-broker and admin channels. Hosted import endpoints use client-cert pinning where customer presents a certificate during BYOK import.

5) Audit evidence and logs:
- Sample events and schema included in kms-ops-runbook.pdf. Audit payloads include operation, principal, source ip, import-id, key-id, and a SHA256 fingerprint of the wrapped blob (no raw key material).
- Retention and access: logs are write-once archived monthly; access is via audit API with RBAC.

6) Export controls / attestation:
- Redwood will not export raw customer key material from customer-managed HSMs. For managed HSMs, any export is limited to wrapped blobs and requires dual-signed attestation.
- Neha will produce the signed attestation PDF for Medivance (attached in final packet).

Attachments we will include in the packet: kms-ops-runbook.pdf, hsm-integration-diagram.png, key_rotation_matrix.csv.

Marissa
Senior Product Ops — Redwood Inference

Quick answers (high level):

- HSM support: AWS CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM, Thales Luna, SafeNet for on-prem. See diagram (hsm-integration-diagram.png).
- Rotation: default 90d for DEKs, annual for wrapping keys; API hooks and webhook events available.
- TLS: TLS1.3 recommended; TLS1.2 supported with AEAD suites; mTLS available for admin/import in Dedicated/Private.
- Audit evidence: sample events exported in kms-ops-runbook.pdf; retention configurable up to 7 years.
- Signed attestation: attached redwood_byo_attestation_signed.pdf — states Redwood will not export raw key material from customer-managed HSMs; includes signatory and date.
